key_insight: This paper proposes a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in medical multimodal LLMs by injecting verifiable anatomical evidence into both vision and reasoning.
clinical_relevance: It could make clinical VQA and radiology-style outputs more trustworthy by keeping model answers better aligned with image evidence.
method: Uses ROI priors from MedSAM to guide visual attention/activation.
Converts anatomical coordinates into semantic tokens as external memory for reasoning.
Adds a task-aware router to choose the right intervention for each query.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 2 tasks and 5 datasets with LLaVA-1.5-7B, LLaVA-Med-1.5-7B, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL-3.5, showing up to ~6% higher closed-ended accuracy and ~35% lower open-ended hallucinations.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on reliable ROI priors and may be harder to reproduce when anatomical localization is noisy or unavailable.
paper_title: Synergistic Perception-Reasoning Governance: Grounding Medical MLLMs with Verifiable Anatomical Evidence
